headline: US Jury Finds Huawei Guilty of Trade Secret Theft
summary: A US federal jury in New York convicted Huawei of stealing trade secrets, while acquitting the company on racketeering charges following a multi-month trial.
why: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese multinational technology vendor providing telecommunications infrastructure and consumer electronics.

impacts.name: Huawei
impacts.why: Legal guilty verdict in US federal court adds regulatory and reputational pressure on Huawei's international operations.
